Synopsis:
Dialog with Blurg in the Lodge.Blurg is present there in case the gith massacre hasn't happened and players have met it in UND.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_TheLodge_Blurg.json: Blurg is a gith you may have first met in the Underdark; this scene takes place in the Society/Lodge where Blurg is waiting provided the gith massacre didn’t occur. He presents as a scholarly, research‑minded figure and mentions losing a friend on a field expedition. The player can respond supportively (praising bravery and the value of his research) or teasingly (suggesting he stick to books), which leads to different dialog nodes. Larger, off‑screen outcomes (the Gortash/Iron Throne events, rescues like Omeluum, or companion epilogues) can alter surrounding reactions but aren’t shown in this single exchange.
- UND_MyconidCircle_SocietyOfBrilliance_Scholar.json: The player meets Blurg, a hobgoblin (deep orc) member of the Society of Brilliance, a group of intelligent, neutral monsters working to improve the Underdark. He talks about his research and, if the tadpole is mentioned, brings his mind flayer friend Omeluum to talk to the player. The player can either agree to the mind flayer's help or attack.
- DEN_TieflingLeader_DenIntro.json: This takes place just after a goblin attack at the grove gate that the player helped repel. Zevlor speaks for a band of tiefling refugees from Elturel (shocked by the city’s “Descent”) and is bitter and mistrustful of the druids who have been reluctantly hosting them. He initially flashes anger (especially if provoked or struck), then composes himself when he realises the player saved the grove and could actually help. Off‑screen, the druids — led by the new First Druid Kagha — are beginning a ritual to cut the grove off and are forcing outsiders out, so Zevlor hopes the player might persuade Kagha to buy his people more time.
- LOW_Elfsong_Githyanki_InquisitorInterrogation.json: Dialog when the Githyanki in the Knights of the Shield hideout spots the player.
- DEN_AttackOnDen_BirdSender.json: This dialogue takes place in two different states. The first is after the player has successfully fought back an army of goblins that attacked the druid grove. In the second state, the goblin leaders have been killed and the tieflings in the grove are leaving. She's aware of the hard work ahead required to make things go back to normal, but she's hopeful all the same.There's an extra node to acknowledge the missing idol, if it went missing before one of those two states were triggered.

context: This exchange takes place in the Society/Lodge with Blurg, a scholarly gith who only appears here if the gith massacre did not occur; you may have first met him in the Underdark. He presents as a research‑minded member of the Society of Brilliance and is still dealing with the recent loss of a friend on a field expedition, which colors his remarks about risk and duty. The player can respond supportively (praising his bravery and the value of his work) or teasingly (telling him to stick to books), which lead to different dialog nodes and tones. Earlier Underdark encounters (where he mentioned contacts like the mind flayer Omeluum) and larger off‑screen events can affect reactions but are not shown in this single exchange.
